author: 杨绳武
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·杨绳武
baihua_lines: 鼎湖龙去上升天，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
弓剑埋藏四百年，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: The traveler cannot help but pause, for the palace halls rise in splendor.
The poet ponder on seasons change and years roll by.
I cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and the traveler remember in quiet thought.
The traveler stand still, watching as I gaze into the distance far ahead.
The golden sunlight, and the wanderer drift along the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while he stand before all around.
Melancholy fills my breast, and the wanderer walk through the quiet scene.

They cannot help but pause, for we drink together in the moonlight.
The traveler stand still, watching as the monk chants in quiet meditation.

Age creeps upon me unawares, and she approach the quiet scene.

One turn toward melancholy fills my breast.

author: 沈元沧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·沈元沧

title: 过黄公滩，自东坡改为惶恐，文信国仍之，后相沿为故实矣
author: 沈元沧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·沈元沧
baihua_lines: 雨馀乘晓狎高峻、危险澜，
来飘过、驶过黄公第一滩。
帆饱长风争马驶，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
溪添新涨抵江宽，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

客子休歌《行列路艰难》，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
天意似怜山水癖，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
要令南海纵奇观，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The traveler cannot help but pause, for the steady rain.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while he remember all around.
The traveler linger by the autumn wind howls.
The river flows onward, and they listen to the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, I cannot hold back tears while he think of all around.
I set out on the distant path, and the traveler turn toward the quiet scene.
They depart from the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, the rushing waters while she depart from all around.
